metadata.case_name: PETER THURSTON PIPER AND ANOTHER v. NANCY FRANCIS TANG

injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: posterior fusion of vertebrae L4-5 and L5-S1, bilateral screw fixation of the posterior joints and an onlay bone graft
source: an operation was carried out on the plaintiff's spine consisting of posterior fusion of vertebrae L4-5 and L5-S1, bilateral screw fixation of the posterior joints and an onlay bone graft taken from the left sacro-iliac crest.
injuries.icd_description: Fracture of lumbar spine or pelvis

injuries.description: donor site injury / pain from bone graft taken from the left sacro-iliac crest
source: onlay bone graft taken from the left sacro-iliac crest
She still had considerable pain in her back and left hip, the donor area, and could not sleep on her left side, which is her normal side for sleeping, for several weeks.
injuries.icd_description: Other specified injuries to the abdomen, lower back, lumbar spine or pelvis

manifestations.description: severe pains in her lower back
intense pain requiring time off work
difficulty getting out of bed and 'loosened up' in the morning taking about 1/2 hour and using the wall for support
had to lie on the floor for relief
considerable pain in her back and left hip
could not sleep on her left side (normal side for sleeping) for several weeks
aches and pains in her back and hip, and an ache in her groin which persist even now (though not all at the same time)
good range of forward bending and rotation from side to side but stiff in backwards bending of the spine
vulnerable to injury to her back

treatments_received: posterior fusion of vertebrae L4-5 and L5-S1 with bilateral screw fixation and onlay bone graft taken from the left sacro-iliac crest
corset with addition of metal rods

losses.category: Loss of ability to engage in sports and hobbies
losses.description: Previously took part in squash, badminton, drama and keep fit; will either be impossible or difficult to return to these activities; used to enjoy dancing but can now only do so in a very limited fashion.
Unable to take her children out as much as before the accident.
Social life is curtailed; used to drive the family around but now drives as little as possible and uses public transport; queuing for taxis is a strain and shopping is difficult.
Cannot go out for long periods without undue pain occurring in her back; shopping and other activities are difficult.

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Unable to do housework and employed a full-time amah to carry out housework.

comparable_cases.injury_description: whiplash injuries to her neck; plaintiff was a female of 38
